title: Clone the repo
note: examples/notes is the front-door example: accounts, sessions, CSRF, flash, and owner-scoped notes — 163 lines of domain code.

title: Run it
note: Visit localhost:8080 — sign up, write a note. Open a private window, sign up as someone else, and try to reach the first account's note by URL: 404. That isolation is the framework's owner-scoping contract, and the same check runs as a test suite in CI.

title: Start your own
cmd:
go install github.com/carlosframework/rastrillo/cmd/rastrillo@latest
rastrillo new myapp && cd myapp && go mod tidy && go test ./...
note: The scaffold is the same five-file shape, tests passing before you write a line. Then read SKILL.md — the whole app story in one file. Building with an agent? That file is exactly what it should load.
